verses.t: By the sky containing great stars
verses.pickthall: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars
verses.yusufAli: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs
verses.rodwell: BY the star-bespangled Heaven
verses.sale: By the heaven adorned with signs

verses.t: And [by] the promised Day
verses.pickthall: And by the Promised Day
verses.yusufAli: By the promised Day (of Judgment)
verses.rodwell: By the promised Day
verses.sale: by the promised day of judgment

verses.t: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed
verses.pickthall: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony
verses.yusufAli: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness
verses.rodwell: By the witness and the witnessed
verses.sale: by the witness, and the witnessed

verses.t: Cursed were the companions of the trench
verses.pickthall: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
verses.yusufAli: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire)
verses.rodwell: Cursed the masters of the trench
verses.sale: cursed were the contrivers of the pit

verses.t: [Containing] the fire full of fuel
verses.pickthall: Of the fuel-fed fire
verses.yusufAli: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel
verses.rodwell: Of the fuel-fed fire
verses.sale: of fire supplied with fuel

verses.t: When they were sitting near it
verses.pickthall: When they sat by it
verses.yusufAli: Behold! they sat over against the (fire)
verses.rodwell: When they sat around it
verses.sale: when they sat round the same

verses.t: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses
verses.pickthall: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers
verses.yusufAli: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers
verses.rodwell: Witnesses of what they inflicted on the believers
verses.sale: and were witnesses of what they did against the true believers

verses.t: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy
verses.pickthall: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise
verses.yusufAli: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise
verses.rodwell: Nor did they torment them but for their faith in God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy
verses.sale: And they afflicted them for no other reason, but because they believed in the mighty, the glorious God

verses.t: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness
verses.pickthall: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness
verses.yusufAli: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things
verses.rodwell: His the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth; and God is the witness of everything
verses.sale: unto whom belongeth the kingdom of heaven and earth: And God is witness of all things

verses.t: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire
verses.pickthall: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning
verses.yusufAli: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire
verses.rodwell: Verily, those who vexed the believers, men and women, and repented not, doth the torment of Hell, and the torment of the burning, await
verses.sale: Verily for those who persecute the true believers of either sex, and afterwards repent not, is prepared the torment of hell; and they shall suffer the pain of burning

verses.t: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success
verses.yusufAli: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires)
verses.rodwell: But for those who shall have believed and done the things that be right, are the Gardens beneath whose shades the rivers flow. This the immense bliss
verses.sale: But for those who believe, and do that which is right, are destined gardens beneath which rivers flow: This shall be great felicity

verses.t: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe
verses.pickthall: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern
verses.yusufAli: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord
verses.rodwell: Verily, right terrible will be thy Lord's vengeance
verses.sale: Verily the vengeance of thy Lord is severe

verses.t: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats
verses.pickthall: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth
verses.yusufAli: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life)
verses.rodwell: He it is who produceth all things, and causeth them to return
verses.sale: He createth, and He restoreth to life

verses.t: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate
verses.pickthall: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving
verses.yusufAli: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness
verses.rodwell: And is He the Indulgent, the Loving
verses.sale: He is inclined to forgive, and gracious

verses.t: Honorable Owner of the Throne
verses.pickthall: Lord of the Throne of Glory
verses.yusufAli: Lord of the Throne of Glory
verses.rodwell: Possessor of the Glorious throne
verses.sale: The possessor of the glorious throne

verses.t: Effecter of what He intends
verses.pickthall: Doer of what He will
verses.yusufAli: Doer (without let) of all that He intends
verses.rodwell: Worker of that he willeth
verses.sale: who effecteth that which He pleaseth

verses.t: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers
verses.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
verses.yusufAli: Has the story reached thee, of the forces
verses.rodwell: Hath not the story reached thee of the hosts
verses.sale: Hath not the story of the hosts

verses.t: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud
verses.pickthall: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud
verses.yusufAli: Of Pharaoh and the Thamud
verses.rodwell: Of Pharaoh and Themoud
verses.sale: of Pharaoh, and of Thamud, reached thee

verses.t: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial
verses.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
verses.yusufAli: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)
verses.rodwell: Nay! the infields are all for denial
verses.sale: Yet the unbelievers cease not to accuse the divine revelations of falsehood

verses.t: While Allah encompasses them from behind
verses.pickthall: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them
verses.yusufAli: But Allah doth encompass them from behind
verses.rodwell: But God surroundeth them from behind
verses.sale: But God encompasseth them behind, that they cannot escape

verses.t: But this is an honored Qur'an
verses.pickthall: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an
verses.yusufAli: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an
verses.rodwell: Yet it is a glorious Koran
verses.sale: Verily that which they reject is a glorious Koran

verses.t: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate
verses.pickthall: On a guarded tablet
verses.yusufAli: (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved
verses.rodwell: Written on the preserved Table
verses.sale: the original whereof is written in a table kept in heaven
